evals.prompt: 我的 UE5.3 插件编译报错 error C2061: syntax error: identifier FZoneGraphBuildData, 怎么修复这个错误?
evals.expected_output: A detailed answer explaining the missing include/module dependency causing C2061, with specific fix steps (add include or module to Build.cs), and at least one reference to official UE docs.

assertions.name: returns_answer
assertions.description: The query returns a non-empty answer (AgentAnswer or HtmlAnswer)

assertions.name: has_references
assertions.description: At least one official Epic reference URL is returned

assertions.name: mentions_build_cs
assertions.description: Answer mentions .Build.cs or module dependencies as part of the fix

assertions.name: mentions_include
assertions.description: Answer mentions #include or header file as a potential fix

evals.prompt: How does UE5 World Partition work? How do I enable it for an existing level?
evals.expected_output: An explanation of World Partition with steps to enable it, mentioning streaming, data layers, or level conversion. Should have references to official docs.

assertions.name: returns_answer
assertions.description: The query returns a non-empty answer

assertions.name: has_references
assertions.description: At least one official Epic reference URL is returned

assertions.name: explains_concept
assertions.description: Answer explains what World Partition is (streaming, cells, grids, or data layers)

assertions.name: has_enable_steps
assertions.description: Answer includes steps or instructions for enabling World Partition

evals.prompt: UE5 build error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol UE::MovieScene::FEntityManager::FindOrAddTypelessComponent - What module dependency is likely missing in the .Build.cs file?
evals.expected_output: Answer identifies the missing module (likely MovieScene or MovieSceneCore) and shows how to add it to Build.cs. Should mention the specific module name.

assertions.name: returns_answer
assertions.description: The query returns a non-empty answer

assertions.name: has_references
assertions.description: At least one official Epic reference URL is returned

assertions.name: identifies_module
assertions.description: Answer mentions MovieScene or a specific module name as the missing dependency

assertions.name: shows_build_cs_fix
assertions.description: Answer shows the Build.cs code change needed (PublicDependencyModuleNames or PrivateDependencyModuleNames)
